summary: Implemented usage_metrics and daily_sessions using effective reconciled-response pricing and compact indexed day/model presence in the existing dashboard read snapshot.

implementation.usage_metrics: Exact six shared API fields; ratios use aggregate original counters, null for zero/invalid denominators; cached-token coverage distinguishes no-cache, unknown and partial pricing; signed discount is summed without response rounding.
implementation.pricing: estimate_token_cost now returns cache_discount_usd calculated from its already-selected effective rates. Existing date/tier/context/assumed-Fast selection and cache-write charges are reused unchanged.
implementation.daily_sessions: Chronological sparse day/chats/subagents/system_agents rows. COUNT DISTINCT session IDs by canonical category over compact presence records. Pre-creation activity is excluded using earliest canonical segment creation per session. Day/model presence includes activity with no usage. Original one-activity-row-per-day compact contract is retained.
implementation.filters_snapshot: Uses the existing date, project membership/alias, model and canonical source clauses, timezone and same SQLite read transaction/revision as dashboard aggregates.
implementation.performance: Dashboard queries only indexed records/buckets, never raw facts. Presence creation/model recovery happens during projection. Additive cache discount and priced cached-token counters are stored on both raw records and buckets.

migration.startup: Store performs only lightweight nullable column additions. Existing deferred GUI projection maintenance is retained; startup can read cached rows without missing-column errors. Cached tokens lacking migrated facts show null discount and zero pricing coverage, never fully priced zero. daily_sessions is empty until projection version 2 commits.
migration.upgrade: Normal ensure_projection atomically rebuilds records and buckets from canonical/candidate facts, including offline and imported facts; version and revision advance only on successful commit. Existing rollback, projection queue and deferred startup behavior remain intact.
migration.bucket_compatibility: Explicit INSERT column lists handle both fresh table column order and old tables with appended migration columns.

Frontend should use exact usage_metrics/daily_sessions names from the shared plan and fill missing days with inclusive date_bounds. Daily counts are presence counts, not newly created chats and not additive all-range totals.
Existing GUI maintenance shows cached summary while migration runs. daily_sessions=[] until version 2; discount coverage remains conservative on unmigrated cached tokens.
Source filtering intentionally follows the selected canonical winner, as existing analytics do; exact copied physical sources do not create duplicate counts.
Synthetic dedicated tests cover both agent categories; longstanding demo totals were not changed. Portable/demo model recovery uses logged per-event model fields when contexts are absent.

Public report serialization already preserves the new fields; dedicated backend test verified it. Full production frontend builds and browser/offline acceptance remain with interface/integration owners.
